trailhead.label: car park P 7 on the south shore at Techendorf, the board’s start (Nordic Walking centre “Süd”)

cautions: About 80 m on the lakeside road (L7a) at Techendorf, signed 30 km/h: keep your dog close.
Forest tracks open to forestry vehicles.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.car park P 7 on the south shore at Teche: parcheggio P 7 sulla riva sud a Techendorf, partenza indicata dalla scheda ufficiale (centro di nordic walking “Süd”)
textIt.About 80 m on the lakeside road (L7a) at: Circa 80 m sulla strada lungolago (L7a) a Techendorf, con limite di 30 km/h: tieni il cane vicino.
Strade forestali aperte ai mezzi forestali.
